summary: D.C. election officials have raised concerns about National Guard presence near ballot drop boxes, while advocates have highlighted multiple recent attacks on local authority and committed efforts to advance statehood. The coverage reflects ongoing tensions over federal control and local autonomy in the District. Without statehood, D.C. cannot prevent Congress or federal agencies from overriding decisions made by elected District officials.
